experiment: single-16-bit-container FFN1 headroom, no-gradient training-only scales
scope: only the 12 FFN1 first linear layers 99x64 @ 64x256 + bias
metric: per-layer RMS(error)/max(RMS(FP32),1e-8) over all validation samples and 99x256 outputs; worst of the 12 layers
calibration: per-layer activation max over the training split; per-output-channel weight max over the frozen FP32 weights; zero point 0, symmetric
arithmetic: signed integer A/W GEMM, INT32 bias, INT32 accumulate; FP64 decode only to measure error
